payload.claim: removed_name_readers relies on git grep never listing a symlink as a match, so a symlink reader is silently absent from the refusal's candidate set rather than causing a false refusal. The task's own notes say this was measured only on the host's git 2.54.0 and is explicitly unmeasured on the cell image's git 2.39.5, and no test drives a symlink reader at all. If the cell's older git lists symlinks differently, a real reader outside touches could go undetected and the task would start its cell instead of being refused, which is the exact failure mode (SA-0269) this change exists to catch.
